name: [🎃] Grapple Strike
desc:
🪝 GRAPPLE STRIKE 🪝

Swing, fly and shoot your way to the top! Two grappling hooks, one per hand, let you whip around buildings, slingshot across maps and hunt players from any angle.

🔫 Grab weapons around the map: pistols, shotguns, snipers, railguns, rocket launchers and more
🗺️ 9 maps: City, Skyscraper, Islands, Factory, Train, Suburb and more
🎮 Modes: Free For All, Gun Game and Team battles
🏆 RANKED: hit level 10 and climb from Bronze all the way to Grand Grapple Master
👕 Unlock outfits, kill effects and custom skin colours
📅 Daily challenges, daily rewards and leaderboards for wins, kills and playtime
🎟️ Hit the Codes button for free coins!

📱 Works on PC, phone, tablet and console. Move and resize your phone buttons in Settings.

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for more updates!

INSPIRED BY GRAPPLES GALORE

llm.loop: spawn in an arena -> swing with two grappling hooks -> grab weapons and kill players -> earn coins and rank -> unlock outfits and effects
llm.objectives: win FFA/team matches and climb ranks
llm.instructions: Swing with dual grapples, grab map weapons, modes FFA/Gun Game/Teams, ranked from level 10
llm.thumbnails: Spider-Man style avatars swinging and shooting
llm.complexity_notes: custom grapple physics, 9 maps, ranked system
